list.name: Changes
list.comment:
feat(build): configure proxy and optimize build output
Add proxy to enable API requests to localhost:4000. Improve build performance by splitting code into chunks. This enhances development experience and reduces bundle size.

task.summary:
chore(ide): remove unused ide settings
Remove unnecessary IntelliJ IDEA settings to reduce project clutter and improve collaboration. This change helps keep the project repository clean.

refactor(dataProvider): switch to dynamic API or static snapshot
Use live API when VITE_API_URL is set, otherwise fall back to static JSON data. This improves flexibility and allows for easier development and testing. Reduces need for manual data updates.

chore(package): update dependencies and package info
Remove unnecessary fields from package.json to improve project configuration. Add ra-data-simple-rest dependency to enhance data handling capabilities. This simplifies the project structure and reduces dependencies.

fix(index.html): update favicon link
Update favicon to use correct SVG file to maintain visual consistency. This improves overall user experience.

chore(config): update project metadata
Remove outdated user ID and add migration status to improve project configuration consistency. This reflects recent changes in user identification.

feat(server): add express server with dotenv and PostgreSQL support
Introduce an Express-based server with added support for environment variables using dotenv and PostgreSQL database integration. Additionally, include a new `dev:full` script for concurrent server and client development.

feat(components): add LastUpdated component
Display last update timestamp to improve user experience and provide transparency about data freshness. This enhances overall dashboard usability and trustworthiness.

feat(dashboard): add last updated component
Improve dashboard by displaying last updated information to users. This enhances transparency and user trust. The component is added above the station cards section.

feat(components): add LastUpdated component
Display last update timestamp and statistics about records and cities. Improve user experience by providing real-time data updates. Enhance dashboard with additional information.

remove(components/LastUpdated): delete unused component
Component is no longer used in the application and its removal simplifies the codebase. This reduces maintenance overhead and improves overall quality.

chore(deployment): configure Vercel deployment settings
Add Vercel configuration to enable seamless deployment of the application. This includes ignoring Vercel files and setting up build and route configurations. This improves the overall deployment process.

chore(build): update vercel configuration
Add includeFiles config to vercel node build to improve build process and reduce errors. This enhances the overall build reliability and performance of the application.

chore(package.json): add vercel-build script
Add new script to improve deployment process to Vercel. This enhances the automated build process for production environment. Improves overall workflow.
